svg.title: Recording audio linked to notes
svg.text: Osmosis moves water across a membrane
The cell swells when the water outside is purer than the water inside
Question for Thursday: how does this differ from diffusion?

g.text: Title bar drag area: keep 200+ px empty
Title bar shows Recording and the time
Recording block: takes the audio’s place in the page, never covers the title
Writing and drawing while recording are time-stamped
Later, Alt+click a word or stroke to hear when you wrote it
